<ng-content select="[default]" *ngIf="state == 'initial'"></ng-content>
<ng-content select="[working]" *ngIf="state == 'working'"></ng-content>
<ng-content select="[done]" *ngIf="state == 'done'"></ng-content>
import { Component, HostListener, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

type State = 'initial' | 'working' | 'done';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-state-button',
  templateUrl: './state-button.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./state-button.component.css'],
})
export class StateButtonComponent<T> {
  @Input()
  action: Observable<T>;

  state: State = 'initial';

  @HostListener('click')
  triggerAction() {
    this.state = 'working';
    this.action.subscribe(() => (this.state = 'done'));
  }
}
